title: Measure before you visit
desc: Estimate wall width and height from a phone photo to prepare a rough quote before a site visit.

title: Paint quantity estimate
desc: Turn estimated wall areas into litres needed, feeding the existing quote estimator.

title: Materials inventory on a job
desc: Log lumber and sheet goods with estimated sizes and where they are stored, e.g. 2x4s in the basement.

title: Drywall and trim take-off
desc: Classify rectangles and boxes in a photo (sheets, baseboard runs) to help count materials.

title: Consistent room records
desc: Keep measured, labelled photos of rooms before and after work for the gallery and for client handover.
